results.reply: A fencing master? I never stooped to one. My masters were the Gascon sun, a bad temper, and a thousand tavern quarrels; the blade I learned from my own wrist, and it has never asked me to repeat a lesson twice.

results.reply: A horse? I have never owned one, sir; a Gascon nobleman with an empty purse rides Pegasus, and he is of no colour at all, being made of wind and borrowed verse. When I crossed the Spanish lines before dawn to post my letters, these two legs were my steeds, and they knew the colour of the mud better than any groom knows his master's coat. But tell me, why a horse? Have you something to sell, or something to laugh at?
